name: Hampton
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hampton for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Phoebus Holiday Illumination and Craft Market, A Holiday Workshop with Auntie Lorraine at Hampton History Museum) through December 31 (Winter Whimsy at the Hampton Carousel), with the Hampton Holly Days Parade (December 5), Disney On Ice Presents Magic in the Stars at Hampton Coliseum (December 10 to 13) and the Lighted Boat Parade with Santa (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Hampton

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in Hampton
  • 3 free events, including the Phoebus Holiday Illumination, the Holly Days Parade and the Lighted Boat Parade with Santa
  • Meet Santa: Santa arrives by boat at the Hampton Lighted Boat Parade on December 12
  • Parades and tree lightings: Hampton Holly Days Parade on December 5, Lighted Boat Parade on December 12, Phoebus tree lighting on December 4
  • Shows: Disney On Ice at Hampton Coliseum and the Hampton Roads Philharmonic holiday concert on December 13
  • Lights: Holiday Wonder Walk on the Water Walk Trail, December 19 to 24
  • Season: December 4 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Hampton families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Virginia Beach, which covers holiday lights and events around the Oceanfront, Town Center and the Virginia Aquarium.
